_comment: models 站系列简介（summary）的英文。2026-10-04。键 = 系列 code。只有 7 个系列。
_note: **逐条对照中文原文译，不凭印象写。** 第一版我凭对系列的印象写译文，
_lesson: 与实际数据核对后发现 7 条里有 5 条内容不符（如 qwen3-8 原文只说「热度最高的一个」，我写成「most sought-after」还算接近，但 deepseek-v4 我编了「Flash build」而原文根本没提）。**翻译必须以原文为唯一依据。**
deepseek-v4: MIT licensed with an active quantisation ecosystem — the quantisations are maintained by antirez (author of llama.cpp) himself.
gemma-4: Google's newest open-weight generation; all three sizes have quantisation coverage.
glm-5: Zhipu's newest generation; the MIT-licensed Flash variant is the friendliest for local deployment.
gpt-oss: OpenAI's only open-weight series; the 20B version is the sweet spot for single-card local deployment.
kimi-k3: Moonshot's newest generation; 41 quantisation repos but middling overall interest.
minicpm5: A representative Chinese small-size model; the 2B scale suits low VRAM and on-device use.
qwen3-8: Alibaba's newest generation; the dense 27B is the most sought-after in the local deployment community.
ornith-1-5: MIT licensed; across its two sizes this has the largest GGUF ecosystem found in this round of stocktaking.
muse-glimmer: Meta's open-weight series, apache-2.0, with quantisation coverage across several major quantisers.
kat-coder: An open-weight series aimed at code, apache-2.0, with 34 third-party quantisation repos.
laguna: An open-weight series in the coding direction; licensed OpenMDW-1.1 (read the original terms before use).
